title: Ministry of Mines Holds Roadshow for Critical Mineral Auctions

blocks.content: The Ministry of Mines, Government of India, is holding a promotional roadshow in Patna, Bihar, on 17 August 2026 for the 8th tranche of Critical and Strategic Mineral Block Auctions. The event is linked to the auction of 20 critical mineral blocks across nine Indian states, with 3 Mining Leases and 17 Composite Licences.
